name: [D14] Bind confirmed ancestry through ledger publication (M)
description:
PRD 00004, cycle 14 decision-gate follow-up. This task is prepared for operator-authorized recovery; do not start while the data_loss_risk pause is unresolved.

### Findings (verbatim)
- high | Confirmed ancestor identities are discarded when `_ensure_directory_chain` returns; replacing `runtime_root` before `deferred.mkdir()` lets publication or replay succeed in a replacement tree whose parent entry was never fsynced, leaving R13-01’s durability risk open. Keep the confirmed runtime ancestry bound through ledger creation/publication and reverify before success. | File: src/ovcaq/workflow/_files.py:288 | Consensus: 2/3
- medium | The replacement regression varies absolute depth but always replaces `runtime.parent`, so an implementation checking only the final two ancestors passes. Commit the retained distance-3/5 probe as an installed regression to bind the every-ancestor requirement. | File: tests/packaging/test_rework_13.py:143 | Consensus: 2/3
- low | B6: `opened` is reused for the parent fstat and then the level fstat (Pat LOW note carried forward) | File: src/ovcaq/workflow/_files.py:262 | Consensus: 1/3

### Acceptance criteria
Every quoted finding no longer reproduces. Preserve all previously accepted crash/retry, exact-replay, peer-creation, directory-identity, state/backup-byte, and installed-wheel origin coverage. Add an installed chronological regression replacing runtime_root after chain confirmation but before deferred mkdir, for direct append and exact replay. Require refusal with a path-specific retryable identity error or proven confirmation of the replacement entry before success; no record loss or false success. Persist the existing distance-3/5 direct/replay probes as regressions. Keep parent and child identities legible. A fix that checks runtime only before the injected replacement, then never rechecks after creation/publication, does not meet acceptance.

Evidence: dev/local/reviews/00004-workflow-core-v1-review-14.md; dev/local/reviews/00004-cycle-14-installed-handoff-probe.json; dev/local/reviews/ancestry_handoff_probe_14.py. Source authority remains P02-T06/P02-T07/P02-T09 and Phase B durable-boundary exit; no public schema/API expansion.
